claim: Nikon CFI Plan Apo Lambda D 4X, part number MRD70040: a dry 4x objective of numerical aperture 0.20 with a working distance of 20 mm, specified for coverglass from 0 to 170 micrometres, which is to say with or without one.

numbers.name: na
numbers.note: as designated by the catalog, to two figures; 0.20 is not 0.2 rounded

validity_conditions: Catalog specification for this part number, capped at E3 because a published specification is not a measurement taken here. The magnification 4x is a nominal designation and a string identifier, not a number, and it is never back-derived from a calibrated pixel size. Transmission at 1064 nm is not part of this entry: the catalog publishes a curve and no numeric table, and a number a model reads off a rendered curve is E6, which may enter nothing.
